confirmedFindings.title: Strict URI Parser Rejects Valid PBX Contact Headers
confirmedFindings.body: The simplified SIP URI regex rejects valid RFC 3261 Contact URIs containing parameters (such as `sip:alice@10.0.0.1:5060;transport=udp`) generated by pbx_device_manager/src/deviceRegistry.ts.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Preserve optional URI parameter parsing `(?:;(.*))?` in the SIP URI regular expression.
